utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and loop in anyone who wants to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming — the repair drive is really on, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still a bit foggy on the exact list, but I think it was mostly the gate and a couple of lane markers. What time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking we start at the community center on Maple around 10, and I’ll keep the gate and lane markers on the list unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. Let me know what tools are still missing and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know which tools we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which parts still need repair for the drive? I want to check the details before I pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — I’m here now and ready to help. What parts still need repair for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the tool list, then I can swing by and see what else we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’m still mixing up the first repair drive spot, but I’ll keep an eye out for the tool list and any updates.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can spread the word and connect folks who want to pitch in—what time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’m flexible on the time, but once you set it, I can bring the tools and help at the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The first repair drive spot is the community center on Maple. If you want, I can keep tracking any updates from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal — that helps. What time does the repair drive start at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening — I’m just lining up the details now. I’ll let you know the time as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — just tell me what’s most urgent for the repair drive when you’ve got a minute.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday morning at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — I’m still checking what tools we’re missing, and I’ll let you know as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—just tell me the plan for the repair drive and what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — I’m still catching up on the exact timing, but it’s Sunday at the community center. If you’re free, I’d appreciate help keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still happening, and the latest update is Sunday at the community center. I’m still pulling together the remaining details, but that’s the main change for now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. Let me know when the rest is set, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What do you still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can still help most with whatever’s most needed—just tell me the item and when you want me there.
